text.en:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a Weapon Kill grants 40% increased damage for a variable duration based on the number of kills achieved before reloading, up to a maximum of 20 seconds. 

Duration is calculated as #e${3} + (2 * Number of Kills) seconds long. Reloading after scoring additional weapon kills adds to this timer and can extend its duration.

enhanced (
#e Buff duration is increased.
)

Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a Weapon Kill grants 40% increased damage for a duration based on the number of kills achieved before reloading.

Base duration is 3 + 2 additional seconds for each kill scored before reloading (One kill is 5 seconds, two kills is 7 seconds...)

Each kill-reload adds its full amount to the currently active timer, extending its duration up to a maximum of 20 seconds.

Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a Weapon Kill grants 40% increased damage for a duration based on the number of kills achieved before reloading. Maximum of 20 seconds.

Base duration is 3 + 2 additional seconds for each kill scored before reloading (One kill is 5 seconds, two kills is 7 seconds...)

Additional kill-reloads will additively stack on top of the currently active timer, extending its duration up to the maximum.
